metadata.default_nutrition_basis: per 100 g edible portion of the exact form in each entry: dry/raw unless otherwise specified; separate cooked, sprouted and processed records
metadata.scope_note: Dry edible pulses plus separately flagged fresh/immature and oilseed legumes and derived foods. Includes Indian dal names and regional Latin American, African, Middle Eastern, East Asian and European varieties.
metadata.quality_note: A subset of values was transcribed from specific USDA SR Legacy records via cited USDA-derived food-profile pages. Those numeric profiles refer only to exactly matched generic species and preparation (typically dry raw seed), not other colors, cultivars, dals, recipes, or cooked forms. Null indicates not retrieved or not populated, NOT zero. Phytochemical lists are qualitative class descriptors, not assayed quantities.
metadata.glycemic_index_note: All GI values intentionally null unless a precise tested food and preparation from a primary GI study/database can be linked. Dry-seed composition is not a glycemic-index testing portion; boiled, mashed, canned and processed products may differ.
metadata.classification_note: Per FAO, pulses are dry harvested edible legume seeds not grown mainly for oil. Soybeans and groundnuts are oilseed legumes, and immature seeds/pods are vegetables. Products use separate classification.
metadata.clinical_use_note: Do not use this broad index as a validated clinical prescribing database. Verify variety/form and source at the individual record level before calculating patient menus; consider allergens, G6PD/favism, kidney bean lectin, lupin alkaloids and carbohydrate/renal restrictions.
